releaseNotes: 0.4.4: question bank export (single bank or all), cancellable imports with per-question failure reasons, per-question SQL drafts, continuous list numbering with preserved scroll position, full PostgreSQL error detail/hint/position, screen-reader announcements and a keyboard-navigable question list, a 20000-row result cap, per-bank storage with automatic migration from the legacy single key, DML detection by result set with table and column comparison, and background engine startup. Local-only: no database connection, no network.
